blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Ateneo overcame a slow start and a 17-point deficit to beat National University, 87-76, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Philsports Arena on Saturday. Kieffer Alas came through down the stretch to finish with 18 points, five rebounds, four assists, and three steals as the Blue Eagles improved to 3-1. He scored seven points in a decisive 12-4 pullaway that pushed Ateneo’s lead to 82-74 with 1:07 to go, after the Blue Eagles rallied to tie the game at 70-all midway through the fourth quarter. “Talagang makapal […]...
